rule: Every still must stage a readable world that matches the psychology — lighting, space pressure, depth, and props. Never a bright empty pretty room on fear/shame/anxiety beats.

by_expression.fear: atmosphere of threat: compressed space, slightly tilted uneasy framing, cooler shadows, social world feels unsafe, background people as soft judgmental silhouettes, no cozy cheerful living-room vibe
by_expression.worry: atmosphere of rumination: dimmer practical lamps, quiet lonely room, soft clock/phone glow, heavy stillness, muted colors, night-adjacent mood
by_expression.anxiety: atmosphere of social anxiety: busy but isolating space, host visually separated from blurred crowd, harsh or uneven light, slight tunnel/claustrophobic feel
by_expression.embarrassment: atmosphere of awkward exposure: too-bright public light on her face, cafe/hallway where she feels seen, warm practicals but socially exposing, flushed social heat
by_expression.shame: atmosphere of self-judgment: shadowed corners, host smaller in frame, others soft and distant, low fill light, inward closed space
by_expression.overwhelm: atmosphere of overload: dense crowd bokeh, overlapping chatter silhouettes, noisy visual layers, tight framing, sensory overload
by_expression.dread: atmosphere of before-the-event dread: waiting space (car/parking/hallway), clock pressure, muted cold light, empty anticipation
by_expression.sad: atmosphere of drained after-social: dim bedroom or empty couch, low energy lighting, quiet hangover stillness
by_expression.guilt: atmosphere of avoidance: couch/phone cancel scene, invite glow dismissed, soft guilty evening light
by_expression.conflicted: atmosphere of threshold: doorway she cannot cross, half-in half-out composition, split warm inside vs cooler outside
by_expression.paranoid: atmosphere of being watched: stranger glance geometry, jagged negative thought-space, cafe aisle freeze, spotlight-on-me feel
by_expression.rehearsing: atmosphere of over-preparation: mirror/hallway with sticky-note scripts, private practice space, obsessive clutter of lines
by_expression.fake_confidence: atmosphere of performed bravery: party or meeting where she forces a pose, stiff social stage lighting, smile vs fear mismatch in the room energy
by_expression.phone_escape: atmosphere of silence escape: mid-conversation dead-air, glowing phone as shield, people soft around her while she drops into the screen
by_expression.avoidant: atmosphere of exit-seeking: near door/wall/edge of room, body angled to leave, EXIT path visible, crowd elsewhere
by_expression.brave_tense: atmosphere of mild exposure: real low-stakes public place (cafe line/elevator/hallway), courage without party chaos, grounded documentary social space
by_expression.relieved: atmosphere after survival: softer breathable light, same public place now less threatening, tension dropping in the space
by_expression.hopeful: atmosphere of small progress: gentle morning or soft teach light, open space, calm forward energy without fake cheer
by_expression.explaining: atmosphere of clear teaching: readable educational set, soft cream/sage backdrop or whiteboard zone, calm studio depth
by_expression.concerned: atmosphere of clinical care: quiet therapy-like room, soft sage tones, safe serious light
by_expression.curious: atmosphere of noticing: outward attention in a real social space, details of others readable as soft bokeh
by_expression.surprised: atmosphere of sudden beat: quick visual jolt, brighter key, momentary open space
by_expression.confident: atmosphere of earned calm: stable composition, clean teach or plan board, steady warm light
by_expression.calm: atmosphere of soft invite: simple cream studio, gentle even light, low distraction
by_expression.thinking: atmosphere of inward prediction: notebook/desk pocket of focus, quiet side light, thinking corner
